:::{#def-uniform}
#### Uniform distribution on an interval

The **uniform distribution** on an interval $[\lowend, \highend]$ (@def-uniform-set
with $\measure$ the length),
with $\lowend < \highend$,
is the distribution of a random variable $X$,
written $X \sim \text{Uniform}(\lowend, \highend)$,
that is continuous with [density](#def-pdf)
[@wikipedia_continuous_uniform_distribution]:

$$
f(x) \eqdef \begin{cases}
\frac{1}{\highend - \lowend}, & \lowend \le x \le \highend \\
0, & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$

:::
